commits.message:
chore: adopt EVADE AND DESTROY as the engine base

Adds NOTICE with the upstream MIT credit and a short project header
in the README.
commits.diff:
diff --git a/NOTICE b/NOTICE
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..6a3dcc3
--- /dev/null
+++ b/NOTICE
@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+GAIA mock game
+==============
+
+This repository is a test fixture for GAIA (Game Anomaly Investigation Agent).
+All builds, crash reports and telemetry under ci/ and telemetry/ are synthetic.
+
+The game code is based on EVADE AND DESTROY by KUSANAGI Mitsuhisa
+https://github.com/mikkun/evade-and-destroy
+Copyright (c) 2017 KUSANAGI Mitsuhisa, released under the MIT License (see LICENSE).
+
+Changes made from September 2026 onwards are by the GAIA mock studio team
+and are released under the same MIT License.
diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
index 0f369fe..f64186e 100644
--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -1,3 +1,16 @@
+GAIA mock game (based on EVADE AND DESTROY)
+===========================================
+
+Internal mock game used to exercise GAIA, the Game Anomaly Investigation Agent.
+Every build, crash report and telemetry file in this repository is synthetic (`"source": "mock"`).
+
+Based on [EVADE AND DESTROY](https://github.com/mikkun/evade-and-destroy) by KUSANAGI Mitsuhisa,
+MIT License. See [NOTICE](./NOTICE) and [LICENSE](./LICENSE).
+
+Run locally: `python3 -m http.server -d docs 8000`, then open <http://localhost:8000/>.
+
+---
+
 EVADE AND DESTROY
 =================

commits.author: Daniel Okafor
commits.message:
feat(engine): seeded RNG so runs can be replayed

Replaces Math.random() with EAD.rng() (mulberry32). ?seed=<n> pins
the seed; QA needs identical runs to reproduce crashes.
